projects.title: Make OHI/O 2017
projects.description:
Worked in a team of 3 to build a machine that sorted skittles based on color. Wrote C++ code to calibrate the sensors and an algorithm to translate sensor data to an angle on the motor.

Won first place in the category of Best Sprint

organizations.name: Engineering Ambassadors

-lead tours of up to 25+ prospective students and their families around the College of Engineering
-represent Ohio State Engineering to prospective students and act as a liaison to Industry partners

organizations.name: Society Of Women Engineers
organizations.description:
-Served as an officer for the largest student organization for the College of Engineering
-Collaborated with company recruiters to organize Professional Development events with members
-Worked on a team of 16+ other leaders on strategic planning and vision for the organization
-Collaborated with leaders from the Society of Hispanic Engineers and National Society of Black Engineers to plan an etiquette dinner which impacted over 55+ members across all organizations
-Collaborated with leaders from 4+ other engineering student organizations to plan events and broaden our reach and network across the college
